product_launches.description: Quiqup launched Shop Local, an online platform in the UAE that aggregates local SMEs and brands to increase their visibility and help consumers discover and buy from local businesses.

overview_description.description:
Quiqup is a provider of on-demand, same-day, and scheduled delivery solutions to retailers and restaurants. Quiqup is reinventing the way consumer urban deliveries are done for better business, better cities, and better living. The company empowering any business to deliver a best-in-class delivery experience by creating the next generation of delivery solutions to suit shoppers’ ever-increasing demands. 

Quiqup offers on-demand, same day and scheduled deliveries you can control, a fleet of professional couriers can tap into, and a platform to help them to manage and automate deliveries.

They also work with large businesses to design custom logistics solutions, using its modular tech and operations to create services built with their business needs in mind.

about_short_description.short_description: Quiqup is a provider of on-demand, same-day, and scheduled delivery solutions to retailers and restaurants.

product.name: E-commerce Fulfilment
product.description: Third-party fulfilment covering inventory storage, order receiving, picking, packing, dispatch, and delivery coordination for e-commerce businesses in the UAE.

product.name: Last-Mile Delivery
product.description: Domestic UAE delivery services with scheduled, same-day, next-day, and four-hour options for e-commerce orders, including delivery coordination and optional cash-on-delivery handling.

product.name: International Delivery
product.description: Cross-border shipping services that help UAE e-commerce businesses send orders to international markets through coordinated international delivery and fulfilment operations.

product.name: Quiqup Partner Dashboard
product.description: A web-based logistics portal for booking, submitting, tracking, and managing deliveries and fulfilment workflows, with reporting and operational visibility.

product.name: Real-Time Delivery Tracking
product.description: A branded tracking capability providing automated delivery notifications, courier location updates, estimated delivery information, and customer delivery preferences.

product.name: Returns
product.description: E-commerce returns handling that coordinates the collection and processing of returned orders, with advertised return turnaround of up to two days.
